grammar.title: More and more with 越来越
grammar.explanation: 越来越 (yuè lái yuè) means "more and more" it describes something changing to a greater degree over time. Put it right before an adjective or verb.

sentences.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

sentences.pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ yuè lái yuè hǎo.
sentences.en: His Chinese is getting better and better.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yuè lái yuè nán.
sentences.en: This problem is getting harder and harder.
